meta.codebook_example_note: Rows flagged codebook_example:true appear verbatim as illustrations in CODEBOOK.md, so coders see their intended coding before starting. Report kappa both including and excluding them.
meta.note: machine_codes are the lexical coder output; NOT shown to human coders. Used only to score lexical precision/recall vs human consensus in compute-irr.mjs. Sample is stratified by predicted code and is therefore NOT corpus-representative: corpus prevalence must be estimated from the full lexical run corrected by the precision/recall measured here.
